source.description:
## PROBLEM
Publication is irreversible and needs cumulative review and operator confirmation.
## SUCCESS
Reviewer PASS and exact decision packet; publish only after explicit operator approval.
## SCOPE
Cumulative diffs, tarballs, evidence, npm metadata, release notes.
## NON_GOALS
Reviewer does not publish.
## CONSTRAINTS
SCRUTINY: critical. npm publish always escalates.
## LIBRARIES
Existing release tooling.
## VALIDATION
- [ ] QA/security/obligations/reviewer PASS.
- [ ] Packs and registry checked.
- [ ] Exact publish commands presented for approval.
- [ ] If approved, publish and verify dist-tags/install smoke.
## OUTPUT
Release decision packet and optional publication evidence.
source.title: reviewer: final release and publication gate
